findings.finding: The band/occupancy sum is used only to propose SLSQP workspaces. Final selection invokes unchanged select_strict_candidate over true-guarded candidates; all18 initial component metrics must be nonregressing and at least one strictly improves. No proxy objective or solver-success flag establishes scientific acceptance.

MappingContext decodes the pinned immutable raw33; both wrist values stay exact. make_state constructs full24 q and DGAHandTree.forward checks exact declared target limits without clipping. Independent XML FK and root/palm/forearm composition are checked. Source pose arrays, frames and fields are read-only/identity checked.

The np.clip call creates one explicitly labelled optimizer start over target finger variables only. It does not mutate native arrays or bypass target/landmark/component adoption gates. This seed is not exported as an accepted mapping merely because it was projected.

Context recomputes all28 site errors from actual source/target frames; maximum, SSE and mean use the exact prior saved tightened caps. Variable translation boxes do not replace the actual palm/landmark constraints. Complete final state is independently certified before export.

Complete Nx8 fields use7 matched visual parts followed by signed declared palm union. core.component_metrics validates float64/censoring and creates exactly18 metrics. Normalized constraints have48 terms (18 components,28 sites,SSE,mean). The proxy excludes no matched part, and its250um fitting margin is not a changed acceptance band.

New states are fresh context dictionaries. Cache stores evaluated workspaces; eligible states require all guards and strict component improvement. Current initial state/source fields are not overwritten; final choice may validly retain an earlier feasible candidate despite an unsuccessful or inadmissible solver terminal point.

Three fixed starts, max800 newly evaluated field states/start and2400 total. Deadline is checked before each lookup; an individual field evaluation can finish after the wall cutoff, after which no further fields run. No simulator, inference or training path imported by the reviewed scripts.
